end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Used body position, direction, and examples such as a slide and the letter V.
Om initially said a tilted line was not straight.
They later stated that slanting lines are straight and differ by direction; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping, and slanting lines with Om using body position, direction, and examples. Om correctly identified standing and slanting lines and later corrected the mix-up that a tilted line can still be straight. At home, ask Om to sort drawn lines into standing, sleeping, and slanting groups and explain how their directions differ.
